mode: local binary, MCP stdio with the agent tool profile (engram mcp --tools=agent, 19 tools), fresh store
door: mem_search(query, match_mode="any", limit=10) over MCP stdio; the door is the tool's whole JSON text
not_default: match_mode "any" instead of the tool's default "all" (with "all" a question asked as it is finds nothing); a fresh scratch data directory instead of the default one in the user's home (deletes are soft and the probes' conflict relations stay behind)
